answer: Duplicate identities split the bond, so farming N fakes costs N times the stake plus slashable reputation. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a pearl-tier deposit before voting, and every attestation is logged on a public terrace where peers cross-check history. A juniper-marked challenge round randomly audits a sample, and proven clones forfeit their entire bond to honest peers, making mass fabrication economically irrational. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
